name: Acumen X Cards
instructions: Each card is posted as an ordinary X post whose text is post_text exactly as given; it already ends with card_url, and X turns that link into a playable card. Post one card per post, one game at a time, in 'order'. Do not attach images or media (X builds the card from the link) and do not shorten or change card_url. To make X refresh a card it has cached, append ?v=2 (then ?v=3, ...) to card_url in the post. Never reveal puzzle answers in any post or reply.
